scope: Independent production-code/Skia audit. No browser, WebView, Android device, real model, memory-profiler or timing certification.

results.name: 256 continuous confidence values survive exact-size alpha export without thresholding
color composition uses true alpha in linear light, including partial source alpha
transparent mode multiplies existing alpha and never creates opacity
sparse and dense samplings of the same polyline have bit-identical pixels and plan
reverse traversal and repeated path segments do not compound coverage within one stroke
keep/erase order is replayed and each separate stroke compounds continuously
extreme radius, hardness, signed shifts and feather stay finite in [0,1] at all edges
no-op strengths and empty mask have bit-exact baseline, independent of brush settings
pixel/edge/work budgets reject before input read or canvas allocation
aggregate replay budgets include every refinement and use ordered intermediate dimensions
cancellation prevents composite reads and leaves the source unchanged
allocation failure releases only newly allocated output and preserves source
legacy background replay stays byte-compatible and retains its prior encoded-space blend
preview is rerasterized at working size and original PNG uses original-resolution normalized strokes
green mask inspection is an overlay only and is never committed or exported
manual undo/redo, canceled strokes and zero-strength gestures restore exact recipes
manual replacement while native detection is pending ignores its stale callback
Cancel and tool replacement detach old controls and reject old native results
out-of-order native callbacks cannot overwrite a newer successful mask
native timeout exits loading and permits manual correction without late mutation
JSON project round-trip retains the exact portable base and ordered refinement recipe
refinement uses its own operation-stage dimensions after crop and rotate
replay fails closed if the Portrait UI module is missing
replay fails closed if the mask, operation, or composition module is missing
